sn56.131:1.1: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pittivisayā cutā devesu paccājāyanti atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye pittivisayā cutā pittivisaye paccājāyanti.
sn56.131:1.5: dukkhassa ariyasaccassa dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa dukkha nirodhassa ariyasaccassa dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāya ariyasaccassa.
sn56.131:2.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yogo karaṇīyo ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
sn56.131:3.2: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
